chapter: Basie and life on the road
title: Hampton and Woody Herman hire cheap young players
summary: Leaders hire high school musicians who work cheaply.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Basically, he'll hire somebody, he knows what they can do. He's going to take somebody out, Lionel Hamlin's band, or take somebody out of one of those bands. But Lionel will go to high school and get some guys and tutor them.
Oh really? So he'll get people out of high school?

Yeah, that's why he used to get musicians so cheap. Oh, okay. You know like a guy just coming out of high school and he knows how to play well, he wanted to play with a big band and travel. And Woody Harman was the same way. Woody Harman didn't pay his musicians much. Because all the guys wanted to play with Woody Harman's band, they didn't worry about how much money they wanted. They just wanted to play with Woody Harman? Yeah, they just wanted to know how many solos can they take.
